title: 缺口6.8吉瓦：相当于7座核电站，AI需求激增，谁来填补？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Just put this in context, they have these auctions, so this latest one is for basically the 2028 delivery here going forward.
segments.zh: 简单来说，他们举行拍卖，最新一次是针对2028年的电力交付。

segments.en: Those prices, effectively wholesale prices more or less, have been going up because of everything that's been going on.
segments.zh: 由于各种因素，批发价格一直在上涨。

segments.en: Because everybody needs electricity. They've capped that. Yes.
segments.zh: 因为人人都需要电力，所以他们设定了价格上限。

segments.en: So they had another auction and it was capped at what? $325 a megawatt day, that's the technical thing.
segments.zh: 最近一次拍卖的上限是每兆瓦日325美元。

segments.en: Without that cap, what would it have been? It would have been like more than $500.
segments.zh: 如果没有上限，价格可能会超过500美元。

segments.en: More than $500. And this has been a trend that we've seen for basically the last three auctions.
segments.zh: 超过500美元，这已是过去三次拍卖的趋势。

segments.en: Yeah, the last three auctions. Yeah, so they didn't meet their target.
segments.zh: 是的，过去三次拍卖都未达到目标。

segments.en: They didn't procure enough electricity to meet all the demand they think they're going to need.
segments.zh: 他们未能采购足够的电力来满足预期需求。

segments.en: Did they say what they're going to do in order to do that? Can they do it?
segments.zh: 他们有没有说打算怎么做？能做到吗？

segments.en: Well, they're working on different plans. There's a meeting next week, FERC, the regulator, is having a meeting to sort of figure out how
segments.zh: 他们正在制定不同方案。下周监管机构FERC将开会讨论。

segments.en: So what those numbers are telling us is that the regulators are saying, we're not going to let you charge more than $325 and the people that deliver power that want to build more
segments.zh: 这些数字告诉我们，监管机构表示不会允许收费超过325美元，而希望建设更多发电厂的电力供应商则称需要500美元才值得投入。

segments.en: power plants say we need $500 to make it worth our time.
segments.zh: 电力供应商说需要500美元才值得投入。

segments.en: So give us a context in terms of the stakes here because the grid that we're specifically talking about, as I understand it, is home to Virginia's data center alley.
segments.zh: 请说明一下这里的关键所在，因为我们讨论的这个电网，据我所知，是弗吉尼亚数据中心走廊的所在地。

segments.en: So we're talking about a key corridor here. Well, it's not just data center alley, but yeah, that's there.
segments.zh: 这不仅是数据中心走廊，还是全球最大的数据中心集群，消耗大量电力。

segments.en: It's the biggest cluster of data centers in the world, sucking up tons of power.
segments.zh: 这是全球最大的数据中心集群，消耗大量电力。
